AW-1.painPoint: Chasing clients three or more times for the same documents because they ignore the portal and forget passwords.
AW-1.reply: What cut our repeat chasing most was making the request itself harder to ignore: one message listing exactly what is missing, a fixed date, and a short follow up on a set schedule so nobody has to remember to nag. Since the password problem is what sends people back to email, a plain reply to the email that works as a fallback saves a lot of grief. A shared spreadsheet or Karbon style tracker only helps if someone owns the schedule, so I would pick the cheapest thing that sends the reminders for you before paying for a full suite.
